name: @vayusetu/config
description: Shared Tailwind design tokens for every VayuSetu frontend package. citizen-pwa and admin-dashboard both extend tailwind-preset.cjs so brand color, type scale, and the CPCB AQI / GRAP / alert-severity color ramps stay pixel-identical across apps. Also the /api/v1 route map (api-routes.json) shared by the Vite dev proxy and Firebase Hosting rewrites.
